TextElement delegates to the current nearest FerroUI NameScopeExtensions scope and its find implementation, returning the same live registered object as controls and other text elements. WinUI deferred element realization and automatic runtime renaming/registration are not provided. Template application attaches its actual result scope before callbacks while preserving explicit root scopes; a private weak parent adapter avoids retaining named owners and declaring trees. Real runtime-XAML template lookup, reapplication and destruction are covered without test-side scope attachment. Pending async completion after destruction of an incomplete parent retains existing framework policy. Deferred resources retain a weak scope-chain context so a nested template can skip an expired temporary construction scope and still resolve its live declaring scope, without retaining either named tree or bypassing a live incomplete scope.
